description: Installable single-DGX Spark image-to-geometry recipe using the exact Step1X source and declared DINOv2 configuration/preprocessor inputs, an SM121-native CUDA 13 runtime, deterministic offline input handling, and GLB output. For generated GLBs up to 240 MiB, the linked next step is vonk-forge/step1x-3d-texture-pytorch-single with the same reference image.
title: Step1X-3D geometry pytorch-pipeline single Spark
